limits: Compilation and linking only. No package build, no runtime, IPC or display test of the patched player.

The level reports what libplacebo passed as enhancement_layer_composed when it last read the frame nearest the presented instant. The renderer's reset callback does not name the frame it read without mapping, so every frame of that render not yet attested is cleared; next to such a frame the level can under-report.
It does not distinguish a full enhancement layer from a minimal one.
The +rogdv5.7 package build, its installation on the ROG and the attended check are owner-coordinated.
